name: SWAPP Staking unchecked cToken transferFrom deposit credit
summary: Staking.deposit ignores transferFrom's return value and credits the caller anyway; emergencyWithdraw pays that balance out for any non-stablecoin token. cUSDC returns false on a failed transferFrom, so the attacker 'deposited' the contract's whole cUSDC balance without owning any and emergency-withdrew the real cUSDC backing users' USDC.
notes: Staking is an immutable non-proxy contract; the unchecked transferFrom is in its creation runtime, so the deployment is the reset.

cUSDC is valued at exchangeRateStored() before the exploit with USDC at par (a marginal floor; loss.mjs's DefiLlama price agrees within 0.1%). Later emergencyWithdraw calls (Dec 2025) found no cUSDC left and moved no Staking funds.
